messages:
alice.z: :rotating_light: seeing a sudden spike of 5xx + client timeouts to hosted inference in us-west around 12:10 UTC. customers reporting failures. dashboard: https://metrics.redwood.internal/…

bob.k: which endpoint? model or gateway?

alice.z: root cause looks like gateway->runtime timeouts for /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings

carlos.m: can you paste a sample error? logs?

alice.z: logs show: `upstream timed out after 120s` and `context deadline exceeded`

support-bot: Customer ticket #C-4491 started, affected customers: acme, fintech-app. Severity: high

diane: @oncall-anya can you take lead? I can coordinate support comms

oncall-anya: taking it. running quick repro. curl to staged endpoint returns 504 after 60s

oncall-anya: repro cmd:
```
curl -X POST https://hosted.api.redwood/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"model":"g-large","input":"long prompt...","max_tokens":4096}' -i
```

sre-jen: seeing elevated queue lengths on gpu-pool-3 and high kernel latency. Possible kv-cache stall on warm starts

carlos.m: can we temporarily route traffic to fallback model small-1 to reduce runtime pressure?

oncall-anya: doing a canary reroute of 10% to small-1 now

alice.z: notify support teams and impacted customers on status page

support-bot: Status page updated: "Investigating increased timeouts for hosted inference in us-west". ETA: 30m

diane: also lowering per-tenant concurrency for high-volume customers as a protective measure

oncall-anya: after canary, 5xx rate down ~40% for canary traffic. overall steady but still elevated

sre-jen: applying hotfix to decrease batch window to 10ms to reduce tail latency

oncall-anya: hotfix rolled, monitoring

bob.k: any customer-facing mitigations to offer? suggest retry guidance: exponential backoff + shorter timeouts

diane: action items: 1) run full replay of affected window to validate kv-cache behavior (owner: sre-jen) 2) permanent routing rule to allow faster fallback (owner: carlos.m) 3) update docs + retry guidance for SDKs (owner: bob.k) 4) postmortem within 72h (owner: alice.z) 5) customer follow-up templates (owner: diane)

oncall-anya: putting all items in incident board. tagging customers for direct outreach

alice.z: thanks team. leaving this thread open for postmortem notes and followups :thumbsup:
